title: Notional Examples
slide_intent: Teach designers to adapt a recognizable identity to an object’s printable area and material. A mark on a mug and a message on a shirt solve different reading problems.
strategic_value: CSAIL can carry its identifier, tagline and group affiliation into events and everyday objects without requiring a single composition on every surface.
demonstration: An array of example objects includes a mug, shirts, notebook, tote, badge and stamp. A black shirt carries the tagline while a white shirt carries the mark.
practical_value: Decide whether the object has room for an identifier, a line of language or an affiliation. Choose scale and contrast to suit the substrate.
